# Verity Minecraft

> Verity Minecraft is an independent English download guide for Verity Minecraft Java, Bedrock, and PE-style mobile players.

## Important pages

- [Verity Minecraft Download](https://verityminecraft.blog/): Platform selector with verified-source download buttons.
- [Verity Bedrock Download](https://verityminecraft.blog/bedrock/): Bedrock .mcaddon source notes and install guidance.
- [Verity Java Download](https://verityminecraft.blog/java/): Verity JE Java mod source notes and version guidance.
- [Verity Minecraft PE Guide](https://verityminecraft.blog/minecraft-pe/): PE, mobile, and APK search safety guidance.
- [How to Install Verity Minecraft](https://verityminecraft.blog/how-to-install/): Step-by-step setup and troubleshooting.
- [How to Install Minecraft Java Mods](https://verityminecraft.blog/how-to-install-java-mods/): Fabric, Forge, profile, dependency, mods-folder, and troubleshooting guidance.
- [Verity Minecraft Versions](https://verityminecraft.blog/versions/): Version snapshot and compatibility notes.
- Bedrock resource pack guide: https://verityminecraft.blog/bedrock-resource-packs/
- [Minecraft Bedrock Add-ons Guide](https://verityminecraft.blog/bedrock-addons/): Safe .mcaddon/.mcpack checks, import steps, world activation, and troubleshooting.
- [Minecraft Java vs Bedrock](https://verityminecraft.blog/java-vs-bedrock/): Edition comparison covering devices, mods, crossplay, servers, performance, and Verity file compatibility.
- [Best Minecraft Bedrock Shaders](https://verityminecraft.blog/bedrock-shaders/): Compatibility-first guide to Vibrant Visuals, RTX/PBR, RenderDragon packs, device checks, and safe testing.
- [Minecraft Java Shaders Guide](https://verityminecraft.blog/minecraft-java-shaders/): Java shader choices, Iris and OptiFine loader checks, version matching, safe installation, and test-world troubleshooting.
